overall: The AG found the Peru Board of Selectmen violated the Open Meeting Law by defective notices, inaccurate minutes, off-meeting deliberation, and a late complaint response; it cleared the timing of agenda items.

allegations.summary: Notices for the July 15, 2013 meeting listed the wrong date (July 8), and no notice listed the meeting location.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, each notice we reviewed failed to include the location of the meeting, as required by the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: The Board discussed agenda items and opened public comment before the times listed on the notices (6 P.M. and 7 P.M.), and meetings began earlier than noticed.
allegations.key_passage: We do not, however, find a violation concerning the times at which the Board discussed particular agenda items.

allegations.summary: Minutes for July 22, July 29 and August 5, 2013 recorded discussion items and details that were not discussed, and omitted discussion that occurred.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, the minutes from the Board's meetings held on July 22, 2013; July 29, 2013; and August 5, 2013 are inaccurate because they list discussion items and details that were not, in fact, discussed during the meeting.

allegations.summary: The Board's minutes did not record the place of the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: All of the minutes we reviewed failed to include the place of the meeting, as required.

allegations.summary: Board members discussed a Town Hall front door purchase before the July 22 meeting and approved minutes before the July 29 meeting, outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: the Open Meeting Law requires that public bodies reserve all deliberation for a properly posted meeting.

allegations.summary: The Board did not respond to the complaint within fourteen business days, and missed the extended deadline the AG granted.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board failed to comply with the Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.

Review by the Board of the Attorney General's Open Meeting Law Training Videos and certify to our office within thirty (30) days of this decision, using the attached form, that all Board members have reviewed this determination and the video.
Revise the minutes from the Board's meetings held on July 15, 2013; July 22, 2013; July 29, 2013 and August 5, 2013 in accordance with this determination.
remedy_passage: We order the following: 1) Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
